name: formforge
description: A playful, local-first browser CAD and sculpting workspace.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @formforge/model && npm run build -w @formforge/web && npm run build -w @formforge/api && node scripts/build-cloud.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w @formforge/model && npm run test -w @formforge/web
scripts.check: npm run build -w @formforge/model && npm run typecheck -w @formforge/web && npm run typecheck -w @formforge/api && tsc -p apps/cloud/tsconfig.json
